description: What rent costs right now in one US city or ZIP, no key needed: number of listings and the median, 25th and 75th percentile monthly asking rent, overall and by bedroom count (studio, 1, 2, 3, 4+). Based on listings verified at the source in the last 30 days. Give a state and a city or a ZIP.

beds.description: Only this bedroom count: 0 = studio, 4 = four or more.

city.description: Full city name, e.g. Austin or New York (New York includes its five boroughs). Not a partial match.

include_rooms.description: true = include rooms in shared homes (excluded by default).

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX.

zip.description: Exact 5-digit ZIP code; use instead of or with city.

name: rent_summary
title: US rent statistics for a city or ZIP
